dimensions.name: 容器镜像引用形态 / tag 可变性 / digest / 严重度
dimensions.headline: The deployment does NOT satisfy plan §29.1 (immutable images usable as release evidence). compose pins no digests, and no registry-verifiable manifest digest exists on this host.

interpretation.key_point: Resolving a digest is NOT the same as having an immutable image. Any tag — including version tags like 18, 26.7 and 2-alpine — can be re-pointed. The resolved digest is only a point-in-time snapshot.
interpretation.no_registry_manifest_digest: For all 4 images RepoDigests equals the image config digest byte-for-byte. A genuine registry manifest digest would be a DIFFERENT value. docker manifest inspect also failed, so no manifest digest can be resolved from a registry here.
interpretation.consequence: Because compose pins no digest and no referenceable registry manifest digest exists, any 'docker compose pull' or redeploy can silently swap in different content.
interpretation.reconciliation_note: An independent review reported container-level RepoDigests as <none>; this round measured the image-level field as non-empty but identical to the config digest. Both observations lead to the same substantive conclusion and are recorded here rather than smoothed over.

dimensions.name: IaC 覆盖（compose / systemd / nginx / 监控）
dimensions.headline: checkov and trivy config scanned ZERO files in deploy/. KICS genuinely covered compose.yaml (10 MEDIUM). systemd units and the nginx config have NO automated coverage at all.
key_findings: No blockchain-* systemd unit is installed or active on the deployment host; the platform runs as bare processes (api pid 3413432, worker pid 3413434, vite dev server bound to 0.0.0.0:3000, preview servers on 3001/3002, MCP on 127.0.0.1:8090, host nginx 1.24.0).
None of the 8 systemd units has ANY sandbox hardening (NoNewPrivileges / ProtectSystem / ProtectHome / PrivateTmp / CapabilityBoundingSet / dedicated User=).
nginx CSP, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy apply only to /admin/ and /app-v2/; location /, /api/, /mcp, /openapi.json, /docs and /redoc have none. No HSTS and no server_tokens off.
Positive: the nginx log_format uses $uri rather than $request_uri, so query-string secrets never reach the access logs — this is why the log secret scan is clean.
Positive: every compose port binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
The deployed nginx config is byte-identical to the repo version (sha256 200ef752...c9ccab).
